text: dsh-gov-bp 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的政务 BP 技能包，通过在 DSH 的 skills 注册表中挂载 provider，提供四种可调用的 Markdown 技能：政务 BP 七问评审、九章项目建议书骨架、路演语言转申报语言，以及政企项目报价估算。技能由模型按需调用，适合准备政府试点申报、项目建议书或相关报价材料的团队，用于检查材料结构、转换表达方式并梳理报价口径。实现中列出了四个技能名称，并通过注册接口提供给 DSH；安装文档给出 dsh plugin add 命令。源码未显示需要额外 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-gov-bp adds four Markdown skills to DSH Web: review government proposals, outline them in nine chapters, reframe investor language for applications, and structure project quotes. A provider serves skills through DSH's registry; the entry shows no API key or external service.
帮我看看这份政务项目申报材料还缺哪些关键内容。
想按九章结构整理一份给政府部门看的项目建议书。
Help me turn an investor pitch into language suitable for a government pilot application.
dsh-gov-bp 的功能「政务材料评审」：按七个问题逐项检查项目材料，并提供 0–2 分的判据。模型调用 gov-bp-review 技能时使用。
dsh-gov-bp 的功能「九章提纲」：按固定九章组织政务 BP 或项目建议书，并列出各章必答事项。模型调用 gov-bp-outline 技能时使用。

Government-facing BP skills for [DeepSeekRuntime](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — review, nine-chapter outline, bid-language conversion, and quoting with real person-month math. Four Markdown skills, zero dependencies, no files copied into your skills directory.

dsh-gov-bp README · Why this exists：A 商业计划书 written for an investor and one written for a 政府部门 that approves pilots are different genres. The second one has to answer: which policy document (with its 文号) opened this window, what the market cannot do by itself, what exactly you are asking the government for, why you specifically, what you refuse to do, how the money was computed, and how the pilot stops. Getting any of those wrong is not a style problem — the reviewer simply cannot find what they need.

dsh-gov-bp README · Why this exists：The four skills encode that checklist, the nine-chapter order, the language conversion, and the quoting method. They are methodology + 口径 discipline, not templates with numbers filled in.

dsh-gov-bp README · Skills：| Skill | What it does | Triggers |
|---|---|---|
| `gov-bp-review` | Seven-question review with 0–2 scoring per question, a "do not send" threshold and a fatal-defect list | 评审 BP、这份材料有什么问题、试点申报能不能过 |
| `gov-bp-outline` | Nine-chapter skeleton with the must-answer item per chapter, 政策依据 card format, self-limitation chapter, GB/T 9704 format layer, forbidden-word checks | 写政务 BP、九章骨架、项目建议书结构 |
| `gov-bp-pitch` | Investor-language → application-language conversion table, three narrative foundations, numeric-consistency discipline | 路演稿改申报稿、话术不对、叙事怎么定位 |
| `gov-bp-quote` | Three delivery tiers, bottom-up person-month math, CSBMK rate 口径, four questions that decide 30–50% of the price, low-price no-go zone, secrecy/copyright red lines | 报多少钱、人月单价、成本大头、报价单拆项 |

dsh-gov-bp README · Skills：Each skill ships a `references/` file next to its `SKILL.md` (review cards, chapter checklist, rewrite samples, quoting method). The provider appends the absolute resource directory to the skill body, so the model can read them when it needs the detail.

dsh-gov-bp README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-gov-bp
```

Or from GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:alitrack/dsh-gov-bp
```

Nothing is written into `~/.dsh/skills`: the package registers a **skill provider** over the existing `ctx.skills` registry (the same mechanism the bundled `skill-office` package uses). Removing the plugin removes the skills.

dsh-gov-bp README · Local development：```bash
git clone https://github.com/alitrack/dsh-gov-bp
cd dsh-gov-bp
node --test                      # 13 unit tests, no install needed
node tests/e2e/keyless.mjs       # provider contract + reference integrity

```yaml

dsh-gov-bp README · local-overlay.yml：- insert:
    - id: dsh-gov-bp
      name: '/absolute/path/to/dsh-gov-bp/lib/index.js'
```

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 --patch ./local-overlay.yml "帮我评审这份政务 BP"
```

Full headless e2e (real dsh + a **local** OpenAI-compatible model, no API key): `bash tests/e2e/run_e2e.sh`.

dsh-gov-bp README · Precedence and overrides：The provider registers at rank **650**, below every filesystem root (project `.dsh/skills` 100, project `.agents/skills` 200, custom 300, user `.dsh/skills` 400, user `.agents/skills` 500) and below the bundled packages (600). So a skill you write locally with the same name always wins — you never have to disable the plugin to override one of these.

dsh-gov-bp README · What this package deliberately does not do：- **No fabricated numbers.** The quoting skill tells the model to write 未核到 rather than invent a plausible figure, and carries a 期次 + 数据截止日 discipline for rate anchors. Any rate it quotes is historical and must be re-checked against the current release before a real bid.
- **No legal advice.** The secrecy (涉密) and standards-copyright sections state the boundary and tell you to stop; they do not substitute for a lawyer or a 资质 application.
- **No document rendering.** `gov-bp-outline` covers the GB/T 9704 format layer as a checklist only. If you need actual 公文 typesetting, combine it with a rendering tool rather than expecting this to print.
- **No Hermes-only instructions.** Skill bodies avoid host-specific tool names, so they read the same inside dsh, Claude Code, or a plain chat.
